GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. When qst, rdr said instructed to ride mnt conservatively & have it finish its race off. He said after mnt began awkwardly he eased & settled at rear, & whilst there was an opportunity to allow it to stride to settle outside the leader, bearing in mind instructions, he felt the filly would not have finished the race off as well if ridden along in early stages. He further added he improved into the race from the 600m & in his view was close to enough to win, however the filly peaked on its run over the latter stages. Co-tnr confirmed instructions were to settle with cover.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bounded at the start, shifted in and contacted Bellazaine. Rider Blake Shinn stated he received no specific instructions and, after beginning well, settled the filly worse than midfield due to others showing superior speed. Near the 800m, Mating Call improved quickly around him, and he was held up until passing the 500m. Shinn explained he didn’t shift out earlier as he felt it was too soon given the strong race tempo and preferred to keep the filly comfortable until an opportunity to improve presented itself

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Drifted Back Settled Down 2nd last 10l well back Turn Hard Ridden peeled Middle Of Track ran on well # good from last
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Restrained from its wide barrier and settled towards the rear of the field. When questioned rider reported that passing the 700m he had looked to trail Ferivia into the race however when that runner failed to press forward he elected to wait until passing the 500m before urging his mount along. He added however that as the pace increased at this stage the filly hit a flat spot and despite being urged along failed to make ground. He further added that after straightening the filly commenced to make ground finished the race off well and may be better suited in races over a longer journey.
